purpose: Define role-based access and responsibility boundaries so information is provided, retrieved, analysed, reviewed and published by distinct functions with auditable permissions.
core_principle: ACCESS FOLLOWS FUNCTION; RESPONSIBILITY FOLLOWS AUTHORITY; PUBLICATION REQUIRES REVIEW.

roles.purpose: Provide a question, clarification and optionally citizen-supplied material.
Interpret the citizen question and identify minimum required information.
Retrieve, identify, match and assess evidence.
roles.may: retrieve_sources, record_document_identity, match_property, match_date, extract_observed_facts, assess_sufficiency

roles.purpose: Resolve applicable law, propositions, conditions, exceptions and legal effects.
Check publication requirements and unresolved dependencies.
roles.may: review_trace, audit, evidence_sufficiency, legal_authority, conflicts, procedure, deadline, publication_state

roles.purpose: Publish approved answer snapshots and public evidence explanations.
Maintain system configuration and access controls.

permission_principles: No privilege escalation through downstream state
change_controls: Citizen assertions are recorded as citizen-supplied information.
Review changes require reviewer identity or system actor and reason.
Administrative configuration changes cannot silently alter substantive case history.
hard_stops: Never allow a citizen submission to overwrite an official evidence record.
Never allow a publication layer to bypass review.
Never allow administrative access to silently rewrite substantive case history.
Never expose restricted personal information merely because a user can view the case.
Never treat access to a record as authority to decide its legal effect.
